constraints: Requires whole-raw-ELF reproduction through the actual Ninja command before probing; fails closed on source guard, compile, or fidelity errors.
Generated files stay in build/r64_init_next_level; production source is read-only. Raw instruction equality does not prove relocation, literal, semantic, or TU equality.
This is a bounded experiment over the R64 historical/retained source forms, not an exhaustive source/compiler/flag search or postprocessor-necessity proof.
name: r64_init_next_level_probe
purpose: Reproduce finite full-TU source-form probes and the R64 counterexample to fixed implicit register homes in init_next_level.
usage: Run from a configured worktree after building the raw gauntworld edge; default fifteen cases or repeated --case historical --case rotation6 --case best.
